It was originally built in 1546 as a palace for the French royal family. King Francis I, its first resident, was a lover of art and intended the Louvre to showcase his collection. Subsequent kings greatly expanded the crown's art holdings, with Louis XIV even acquiring the art collection of English King Charles I, after his execution in the English Civil War. The collection remained mainly private until the outbreak of the French Revolution in 1789, and in 1793 the Louvre opened as a public art gallery.  Today, the Louvre displays more than 35,000 works of art - including the famous Mona Lisa painting by Leonardo da Vinci - and attracts around 30,000 daily visitors."},{"@type":"BlogPosting","@id":"https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c62lnennzgdt?post=asset:a0837eb4-d023-42a9-bf1d-cc3c9ff7712a","isAccessibleForFree":"true","headline":"Thieves escaped on a scooter with nine items of jewellery","publisher":{"@type":"NewsMediaOrganization","name":"BBC News","url":"https://www.bbc.co.uk/news","logo":{"@type":"ImageObject","url":"https://static.files.bbci.co.uk/core/website/assets/static/news/images/metadata/poster-1024x576.5f404a8b8b.png"}},"author":{"@type":"NewsMediaOrganization","name":"BBC News","url":"https://www.bbc.co.uk/news","logo":{"@type":"ImageObject","url":"https://static.files.bbci.co.uk/core/website/assets/static/news/images/metadata/poster-1024x576.5f404a8b8b.png"}},"image":"https://static.files.bbci.co.uk/core/website/assets/static/news/images/metadata/poster-1024x576.5f404a8b8b.png","datePublished":"2025-10-19T09:51:22.278Z","dateModified":"2025-10-19T10:01:23.000Z","mainEntityOfPage":"https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c62lnennzgdt","articleBody":"Details are sketchy but French media are reporting that three masked men broke into the Louvre shortly after opening time this morning. class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">According to French media reports, authorities have recovered a damaged crown near the Louvre which reportedly belonged to Empress Eugenie. </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Born in Granada, Spain, in 1826, Empress Eugenie married Napoleon III, who ruled France as president from 1848 to 1852 and emperor from 1852 until 1870, when he was overthrown.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Napoleon III then spent the last three years of his life in exile in England, with Empress Eugenie and his only son, after he was captured and deposed during the Franco-Prussian war.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">When his son - also Napoleon - died in 1879, Empress Eugenie built a monastery and imperial mausoleum in Farnborough.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Empress Eugenie was entombed to the imperial crypt at St Michael's Abbey after she died in 1920.</p>

      <p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Earlier, we reported comments from Culture Minister Rachida Dati who said one stolen item had been found near the Louvre as the thieves made their getaway.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Several French media outlets are reporting that the item is a 19th Century crown belonging to Empress Eugenie and has been found broken.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Eugenie was the wife of Napoleon III, who ruled France in that era. </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">According to Louvre's website, the crown features golden eagles and is covered in 1,354 diamonds and 56 emeralds.</p>

      <p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Thefts from the museum are rare, thanks to its tight
security, but they have happened – most famously in 1911
when Leonardo de Vinci’s masterpiece the Mona Lisa was taken. 
  </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Poet Guillaume Apollinaire and painter Pablo Picasso were
both questioned by police. But, the culprit turned out to be an Italian
man who – out of a sense of national pride – wanted the painting brought back
to Italy.  </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">It was found three years later in Florence and returned to Paris. At the time the painting was not as famous as it is now.  </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Separately, in 1983 some
items of 16th century armour disappeared and were only
rediscovered in 2011.   </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Most recently, a painting by the 19th
century artist Camille Corot was taken in 1998. <i>Le Chemin de Sevres</i>
(The Sevres Road) was simply removed from the wall without anyone seeing. The
theft prompted an important overhaul of security. It has never been found.</p><figure class="ssrcss-hc6arm-StyledFigure e34k3c22"><div class="ssrcss-ab5fd8-StyledFigureContainer e34k3c21"><span class="ssrcss-52w30g-Placeholder etlorgc0"><img alt="The Salle Mollien in the Musee du Louvre" loading="lazy" src="https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/640/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/59e241ea-909b-4173-b032-13caa88caf54.jpg.webp" srcSet="https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/240/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/59e241ea-909b-4173-b032-13caa88caf54.jpg.webp 240w, https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/320/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/59e241ea-909b-4173-b032-13caa88caf54.jpg.webp 320w, https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/480/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/59e241ea-909b-4173-b032-13caa88caf54.jpg.webp 480w, https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/624/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/59e241ea-909b-4173-b032-13caa88caf54.jpg.webp 624w, https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/800/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/59e241ea-909b-4173-b032-13caa88caf54.jpg.webp 800w" width="2121" height="1193" class="ssrcss-egie1y-Image edrdn950"/></span><span role="text" class="ssrcss-tzgxt7-StyledFigureCopyright e34k3c20"><span class="visually-hidden ssrcss-i2z2ig-VisuallyHidden e16en2lz0">Image source, </span>Getty Images</span></div></figure>

This is what we now know: </p><ul class="ssrcss-1ynsflq-UnorderedList e1q8fsc70"><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      Thieves broke into the<b> </b>museum at about 09:30 local time (08:30 BST) - shortly before the attraction opened to visitors - and has been <b>shut for the day</b> as a result
    </li></ul><ul class="ssrcss-1ynsflq-UnorderedList e1q8fsc70"><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      Paris's prosecutor's office added it had opened an investigation into the <b>"theft of jewellery"</b>
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      The thieves are thought to have gained entry via an upstairs window after <b>using a type of mechanised lift </b>to access the first-floor, <a href="https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c62lnennzgdt?post=asset%3A5854adae-fefe-49b5-9888-d1c55a14e125#post" class="ssrcss-1e0jzsh-InlineLink e1kn3p7n0">writes the BBC's Paris correspondent Andrew Harding</a>
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      Interior Minister Laurent Nunez says three or four thieves were able to open two display cases and<b> </b>left the scene on motorbikes
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      Culture Minister Rachida Dati told French TV that in their haste to flee, <b>one stolen item was found</b> underneath the Louvre
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      The targeted gallery - in the museum's south side - holds what remains of France's crown jewels
    </li></ul><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10"></p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">We are staying across the situation and will bring you updates as we get them. </p>

      <p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The Gallery of Apollo, which the thieves are said to have targeted, houses what is left of the French
crown jewels.  </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">These were largely lost or sold after the French Revolution, but
some precious items remained.  </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Pieces housed there included those acquired after the Revolution
for the Emperor Napoleon, his nephew Napoleon III, and their wives the

including one major road along the riverbank in front of it.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The focus of the investigation is on the south-east corner of the
building, overlooking the River Seine. </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">A large, extendable ladder is visible, the sort of thing you might see on a fire engine or roofing company’s
vehicle.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">It is mounted onto a mechanised lift, the type used all around Paris to
deliver furniture to apartments on upper floors.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The top of the ladder touches a balcony, which appears to be
how the three thieves accessed one of the upper floors.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">I have spoken to the mayor of the local area who can’t confirm whether the ladder was already there for maintenance work, or whether the thieves deliberately placed it there. </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The area around is full of tourists milling about unable to
access the Louvre anymore on what is an overcast day.</p>

      <p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">We are now getting more details about how the robbery unfolded. </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The French Interior Ministry says that at around 09:30 local time (08:30 BST) a number of individuals got into the Apollo Gallery via a window, which they broke.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez says three or four thieves involved used a goods lift on a truck outside the building.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Once inside, the thieves stole jewels that were in display cases and then left on motorbikes. class="ssrcss-189b1h2-HeadlineWrap e14e9ror2"><span>What is the Louvre?</span><span class="ssrcss-etauer-ServerSideTime e14e9ror0"><span data-testid="timestamp" class="ssrcss-19b8cwc-Timestamp ekpio9q4"><span data-testid="accessible-timestamp" class="visually-hidden ssrcss-i2z2ig-VisuallyHidden e16en2lz0">published at 11:15 BST 19 October 2025</span><div class="ssrcss-3zvusy-Wrapper King Francis I, its first resident, was a lover of art and intended the Louvre to showcase his collection.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Subsequent kings greatly expanded the crown's art holdings, with Louis XIV even acquiring the art collection of English King Charles I, after his execution in the <a href="https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/topics/zk4cwmn" class="ssrcss-1e0jzsh-InlineLink e1kn3p7n0">English Civil War</a>.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The collection remained mainly private until the outbreak of the <a href="https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/articles/z4xx2v4" class="ssrcss-1e0jzsh-InlineLink e1kn3p7n0">French Revolution</a> in 1789, and in 1793 the Louvre opened as a public art gallery. </p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Today, the Louvre displays more than 35,000 works of art - including the famous Mona Lisa painting by Leonardo da Vinci - and attracts around 30,000 daily visitors.</p><figure class="ssrcss-hc6arm-StyledFigure e34k3c22"><div class="ssrcss-ab5fd8-StyledFigureContainer e34k3c21"><span class="ssrcss-1xlv9qk-Placeholder etlorgc0"><img alt="A woman views the original 1804 painting of "Bonaparte visiting the plague stricken in Jaffa" by French painter Antoine-Jean Gros, on display at the Louvre museum" loading="lazy" src="https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/640/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/6bda5ee1-9a41-4807-b278-3581d5a8f967.jpg.webp" srcSet="https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/240/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/6bda5ee1-9a41-4807-b278-3581d5a8f967.jpg.webp 240w, https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/320/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/6bda5ee1-9a41-4807-b278-3581d5a8f967.jpg.webp 320w, https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/480/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/6bda5ee1-9a41-4807-b278-3581d5a8f967.jpg.webp 480w, https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/594/cpsprodpb/vivo/live/images/2025/10/19/6bda5ee1-9a41-4807-b278-3581d5a8f967.jpg.webp 594w" width="594" height="401" class="ssrcss-egie1y-Image edrdn950"/></span><span role="text" class="ssrcss-tzgxt7-StyledFigureCopyright e34k3c20"><span class="visually-hidden ssrcss-i2z2ig-VisuallyHidden e16en2lz0">Image source, </span>Getty Images</span></div></figure>

      <p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Details are sketchy but French media are reporting that three masked men broke into the Louvre shortly after opening time this morning.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">They’re said to have used a goods lift to get access to the Apollo Gallery, on the Seine River side of the museum.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">This ornate room is where what remains of France’s crown jewels are kept.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">The thieves are said to have been carrying small chainsaws.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">They made off with nine items of jewellery and they escaped on a motor-scooter.       <p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">If you're just joining us, France's Culture Minister, Rachida Dati, says there has been a robbery at the world-famous Louvre museum in Paris.</p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">Here's what we know so far:</p><ul class="ssrcss-1ynsflq-UnorderedList e1q8fsc70"><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      The incident took place this morning as the museum opened
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      There are no injuries, she says
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      The police are at the museum and an investigation is under way
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      A statement from the Louvre says it will remain closed for the day due to "exceptional reasons"
    </li></ul><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10"></p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">And here's what we don't yet know:</p><ul class="ssrcss-1ynsflq-UnorderedList e1q8fsc70"><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      We don't know what - if anything - has been taken from the museum
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      We do not know yet who was involved in the incident
    </li><li spacing="rich-text" class="ssrcss-ugdhan-Stack e1y4nx260">
      It's also unclear how the robbery occurred
    </li></ul><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10"></p><p class="ssrcss-1q0x1qg-Paragraph e1jhz7w10">We'll keep monitoring the situation and bring you updates as we receive them.</p>
